correctness.rationale: Iid uniform circle points imply every forest of distinct edge indicators is independent by iterative leaf integration; thus E E_n=C(n,2)*2r and Var E_n=C(n,2)*(2r)(1−2r). For a triangle the Dirichlet(1,1,1) ordered spacings give exact probability 3r²+(3r−1)_+²; subtracting p³ yields delta(r)=r²(3−8r) for r<=1/3 and (1−2r)³ above 1/3. Expanding centered edge sum cube, only one-edge repeated terms and ordered full triangles remain, so E[(E_n−mp)^3]=m p(1−p)(1−2p)+6*C(n,3)*delta(r). Divide by m: p(1−p)(1−2p)+2(n−2)delta. In upper regime with q=1−2r this factors q[−1+3q+2(n−3)q²], giving exact root r_n=1/2−1/(3+sqrt(8n−15)); lower regime strictly positive and n>=3. For fixed r, Fourier eigenvalues a_k=sin(2pi kr)/(pi k) of degenerate connection kernel and joint CLT yield (E_n−mp)/n⇒sum_{k>=1}a_k(Exp_k(1)−1). Degenerate U-stat tail L2 bound by sum_{k>K}a_k², and Parseval gives variance r(1−2r), triangle trace gives third cumulant delta(r)>0, hence non-Gaussian. Independently 20k-term Fourier checks for r=1/5 and 2/5 reproduced third cumulants .056 and .008 to ~5e−15 and limiting variances to <3e−6; truncations do not prove the limit.
